issues.description: Register-preservation requirement around the address-calculation TODO in main is inconsistent with the required/expected use of ECX. The problem statement explicitly instructs students to read the pixel value into ECX after computing the address ("mov ecx, [esi]"), implying ECX may be clobbered there. However, the template TODO comment for that same section says to save all registers modified "except eax, ebx and esi", which would require preserving ECX if it is loaded as instructed. The reference solution loads ECX there without saving it, matching the problem statement but contradicting the template comment.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template comment with the assignment/solution by excluding ECX from the preservation requirement at that TODO (e.g., "save all registers you modify except eax, ebx, ecx and esi"), or remove the requirement to load the pixel into ECX at that TODO and move the load to a place where ECX preservation is not demanded.
